hero.title: About
hero.lead: We build one calm workspace for serious creators — messages, fans, AI tools, and protection — with voice-first control when you want it.

mission.title: Mission
mission.p1: Tools that used to sit behind agencies should sit behind you. We ship software that respects your time, your data, and the way you already work.
mission.p2: Circe stands for retention and depth. Venus stands for growth and reach. Together they describe one product, not two products bolted together.

dual.circeBody: Retention, rhythm, and protection — fewer leaks in the hull, fewer fires in the inbox.
dual.venusBody: Growth and presentation — clearer offers, cleaner surfaces, more room to scale.

values.title: Principles
values.oneBody: Your accounts and content stay yours. We design for least exposure and clear controls.
values.twoBody: Every surface earns its pixels. No clutter, no dark patterns, no toy dashboards.
values.threeBody: AI assists; you decide. Voice and text stay aligned with how you actually operate.

closing.line: Built by people who ship product and understand the work on the other side of the screen.

cta.title: Start
cta.subtitle: Trial on the site. Billing and plans live in Settings when you are ready.
